name: Hardware Interpolation Approximation
aliases: Piecewise Bilinear/Trilinear Interpolation via Polygon Subdivision
definition: The hardware scheme approximates integration by assuming linear interpolation along ray segments, resulting in piecewise bilinear or trilinear interpolation depending on polygon subdivision.
summary: Hardware Interpolation Approximation is a volume rendering technique that uses GPU rasterization to approximate integration via view-dependent, hardware-enforced piecewise bilinear or trilinear interpolation.
